rationale: The revised plan addresses the reviewer feedback well and stays within metadata-only limits. It reframes behavior as inferred from the issue rather than confirmed inspection, narrows the likely patch target to `Prefix.__mul__`/`__rmul__`, and concretely defines the intended semantics: prefix left-multiplication should mirror unit right-multiplication instead of collapsing via scale-factor logic. It also incorporates the requested caution to keep prefix-prefix simplification limited to actual `Prefix` operands, adds the anti-regression assertions that results are not `1`/`S.One`, and includes both alias (`W`) and named unit (`watt`) coverage. As a plan, this is appropriately scoped and actionable without overclaiming verification.
